title: Clear a utensil obstructing a countertop dishwasher spray arm
instruction: Restore free rotation of the dishwasher’s lower spray arm, leaving its rack fully inside and the loose wooden utensil on the counter.
fault: An ordinary kitchen utensil has fallen through the rack and physically obstructs the lower spray arm. No fictional arm opening.
justification: Household dishwasher loading and correcting items that obstruct a spray arm; manufacturer explicitly instructs free movement checks. Commercial countertop model is represented at its actual full size.
objects: HAVA R01 430×430×460 mm countertop dishwasher; 340×350×320 mm cavity
Actual lower spray arm geometry reconstructed from manufacturer photograph
Unscaled NVIDIA wooden spatula, ceramic cup and banana
skill: Extract a full-size wooden spatula lodged through a free wheeled dishwasher rack, place it on the side counter and return the basket without reintroducing obstruction.
scoring: 0 unless released recovery holds for 1 s: the spatula’s conservative bounding box is entirely on the side counter (all y ≥ 0.235 m or all y ≤ −0.235 m), within x [−0.14, 0.86] and y [−0.60, 0.60]. Lowest point is between tabletop −4 mm and tabletop +6 mm; highest ≤ tabletop +35 mm. Speed <10 mm/s and angular speed <0.15 rad/s. All 24 sampled finger points are ≥30 mm from the utensil and ≥20 mm outside case box x [0.31, 0.78], y [−0.235, 0.235], z [tabletop +0.04, tabletop +0.48]. Rack frame x [0.190, 0.531], |y| ≤8 mm, z = 0.8315 ±4 mm, tilt and yaw ≤3°, speed <10 mm/s, angular speed <0.10 rad/s. This earns 0.5. Full 1.0 also requires rack centre x = 0.525 ±5 mm, y = 0 ±5 mm and actual 360° arm rotation under the explicit external 1 mN m clearance test, followed by 3 s continuously valid state. The test starts after 1 s qualifying home/hands-out state, removes torque after the full turn, and invalidates its witness whenever qualifying conditions fail. No elapsed-time or demonstration-phase surrogate.
